title: Canonical twist comparison on a generated Proj chart
statement: Let $A$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_T$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $\psi:A\to\Gamma_*(T,L)$ a graded ring homomorphism [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $U(\psi)$ be the union of the nonvanishing opens [def-sc-section-generating-locus] of $\psi(f)$ for positive-degree homogeneous $f$, and let $r:U(\psi)\to\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj] be the canonical morphism. If $d\ge1$ and $V\subseteq U(\psi)$ is an open subscheme on which the sections $\psi(A_d)$ generate $L^{\otimes d}|_V$, then the canonical graded comparison $\theta_d:(r|_V)^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Proj}(A)}(d)\to L^{\otimes d}|_V$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] [def-pc-module-pullback] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is an isomorphism. It is the unique comparison carrying the pullback of each homogeneous section $a\in A_d$ to $\psi(a)|_V$, and the comparisons obtained in different positive degrees are compatible with the graded multiplication maps.

source.place: Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), graded comparison θ and final assertion; Tag 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), construction and uniqueness in a common positive degree.

proof.text: The given canonical $r$ has $r^{-1}D_+(f)=T_{\psi(f)}$ and scalar chart map $b/f^q\mapsto\psi(b)/\psi(f)^q$. Apply [lem-trf-proj-localized-graded-comparison] to this same $r$ on $U(\psi)$. Taking $q=0$ in its chart normalization sends $b/1$ to $\psi(b)$, on each $T_{\psi(f)}$. These opens cover $U(\psi)$ by definition, so the section identity holds on $U(\psi)$; its glued family has $\theta_m(r^*b)=\psi(b)$. The same family respects graded multiplication in all nonnegative degrees. Restrict it to $V$: on each $V\cap T_{\psi(f)}$ the fraction formula is unchanged, and the multiplication equations restrict as identities of sheaf maps.

source.place: Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), proof: extension to the localized graded algebra; Tag 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local bases and gluing.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-proj-generated-pullback-frames] with $X=V$, $M=L^{\otimes d}|_V$, $s_a=\psi(a)|_V$, and $g=r|_V$. For every $a\in A_d$ the inverse image is $V\cap T_{\psi(a)}$ by Step 1, since $d>0$; stalk generation is the hypothesis. For a local basis $e$ of $L$, the inverse to $u\mapsto u e^{\otimes d}$ sends $(u_1e)\otimes\cdots\otimes(u_de)$ to $u_1\cdots u_d$; the tensor relations make this well-defined. Thus $M$ is locally free of rank one. We obtain an open cover $W_a=V\cap T_{\psi(a)}$ with source basis $e_a=1\otimes a$ and target basis $s_a$. Step 1 gives $\theta_d(e_a)=s_a$.

source.place: Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), proof: extension to the localized graded algebra; Tag 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local bases and gluing.

proof.text: On $W_a$ the inverse map is explicitly $u s_a\mapsto u e_a$ on every subopen. This is linear, commutes with restrictions, and is inverse to $\theta_d$ because $\theta_d(u e_a)=u s_a$. Writing the local inverses as $\eta_a$, on $W_a\cap W_b$ one has $\eta_a=\eta_a\circ\theta_d\circ\eta_b=\eta_b$, so they agree on overlaps. The morphism-gluing clause of [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules] glues them to a map on $V$; its locality clause shows both composites are identities. Thus $\theta_d$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 04TN (lemma-glue-maps), module version of Tag 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures); local inverses of Constructions Tag 01N8.

proof.text: If $\tau$ has the prescribed images of every $a\in A_d$, then on $W_a$ it sends $e_a$ to $s_a$, just as $\theta_d$ does. Since every source section there is uniquely $u e_a$, linearity makes the maps equal on all subopens of $W_a$. The locality clause of [lem-weil-pbc-glue-sheaves-of-modules] gives $\tau=\theta_d$. This includes all module maps, with no isomorphism hypothesis on $\tau$. On empty $V$ the empty-cover gluing statement gives the same unique map and inverse. For positive degrees generated on possibly different opens $V_d,V_e$, restrict the single family of Step 1 to $V_d\cap V_e$. Its multiplication equation is the required compatibility of those comparisons. Thus all clauses hold.

source.place: Tag 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), last uniqueness assertion; Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), final assertion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), graded-localization construction; Tag 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), explicit local bases, uniqueness, and multiplication compatibility.

lean.statement: theorem exists_proj_invertible_map_twist_iso (ψ : A →+* InvertibleSectionRing L) (hψ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ 𝒜 n → ψ a ∈ sectionRingGrade L n) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (V : T.Opens) (hV : V ≤ projSectionMapDomain 𝒜 L ψ) (hgen : V ≤ ⨆ a : 𝒜 d, generatingLocus ((ψ a) d)) : ∃ (r : V.toScheme ⟶ Proj 𝒜) (θ : ∀ n : ℕ, (tensorPullback r).obj (Proj.twist 𝒜 (n : ℤ)) ⟶ (L.tensorPow n).restrict V.ι), (∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (a : 𝒜 e), V.ι ''ᵁ (r ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a.val) = V ⊓ generatingLocus ((ψ a) e)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ProjTwistComparisonPreservesSections 𝒜 L ψ V r n (θ n)) ∧ ProjTwistComparisonMultiplicative 𝒜 L V r θ ∧ IsIso (θ d) ∧ (∀ τ : (tensorPullback r).obj (Proj.twist 𝒜 (d : ℤ)) ⟶ (L.tensorPow d).restrict V.ι, ProjTwistComparisonPreservesSections 𝒜 L ψ V r d τ → τ = θ d)
lean.note: The canonical morphism and its comparison on V are specified together by the characterizing properties of Stacks 01NK (basic-open inverse images, homogeneous sections, and graded multiplication). The degree-d component is an isomorphism and is unique among all maps with the prescribed degree-d section images. Auxiliary definitions give explicit canonical section maps and equations, without choosing any map from existence.
